notes.title: VIP Elite is Here!
notes.content:
Hello Steam Fans!
We’ve just unleashed a brand-new update and check out this bucket of awesome we’ve dropped with this one –

VIP ELITE
We’re rolling out the red carpet just for you, the VIP Elite Program is now available!  Now you can climb up the VIP ladder simply by playing or making a purchase…the more VIP Points you rack up, the bigger benefits you shall reap!  Reach the highest statuses for bigger bonuses across the board to keep smoking your friends at the tables.
Higher VIP Statuses can get you huge Welcome Chips and Gold Bonuses, increased Chip Purchases Bonuses, higher Spin Wheel Bonuses, and much more!  You’ve been great fans and you deserve to be rewarded for that loyalty.

XP BUFFS FOR SPIN-AND-GO-TOURNAMENTS
The Spin-and-Go Tournaments are more beneficial than ever before.  We have completely overhauled the XP amounts given for participation in EVERY Sit-and-Go Tournament!  We took the prior amounts, loaded them up with steroids, locked them in a gym and jacked them up.  The bigger the buy-in, the greater amounts of XP you shall receive.

Dynamic Derek
